question: Does a post-OSKM-withdrawal, maturation, recovered, or re-differentiated partial-reprogramming phase contain Case 3: DNAm age gain with bounded identity cost and bounded pluripotency risk?
decision: No accession located in this scan met all hard requirements: explicit post-withdrawal or recovered phase, human EPIC or 450k methylation values usable with Horvath353, processed RNA or expression values covering fibroblast identity markers and POU5F1/NANOG/LIN28A/LIN28B/SOX2, and stdlib-readable processed files.
hard_requirements: post-OSKM-withdrawal, maturation, recovered, or re-differentiated samples, not only transient intermediate samples
human EPIC or 450k methylation processed beta values sufficient to score covered Horvath353 CpGs
processed RNA or expression matrix covering identity markers and pluripotency markers
same donor, sample, or phase labels sufficient to join methylation and RNA readbacks
processed files readable with Python stdlib; raw SRA, IDAT-only, RDS-only, H5/H5AD-only, and anti-bot document sources are not sufficient

queries.notes: Wide scan exposed recent partial-reprogramming RNA-only, mouse-only, array-only, RDS-only, and raw-only candidates; inspected candidates are listed below.

queries.source: GEO FTP directory and series_matrix metadata
queries.query: Direct curl inspection of candidate matrix and supplementary directories
queries.notes: Phase labels were checked from !Sample_title, !Sample_source_name_ch1, and !Sample_characteristics_ch1 where series_matrix files were available.

candidates.phase_evidence: Series summary states MPTR uses factor withdrawal after a maturation point, but the SuperSeries supplementary directory only exposes RAW.tar and filelist at the SuperSeries level.
candidates.processed_data: SubSeries have processed data, but the SuperSeries itself does not provide a joined processed methylation plus RNA recovered-phase table.
candidates.reason: Need subseries-level sample labels and processed matrices; the SuperSeries summary alone is not a recover-phase sample certificate.

candidates.reason: Processed RNA is available, but metadata labels are transient/intermediate/fibroblast/iPSC; no explicit post-withdrawal recovered or maturation-after-withdrawal samples were found.

case3_evaluation.reason: No qualified recovered-phase processed dataset was found. Running Case 3 on transient or mouse recovery data would over-claim the requested recovered human EPIC/RNA test.
